Laura / Tessa — I pulled the billing ledger and transaction history for PO-8872. Quick findings:
- INV-2026-2318 was previously issued and paid for the initial implementation milestone (we have a receipt on 2026-07-05).
- INV-2026-2319 appears to be an adjusted invoice (same service lines, slightly different tax rounding) that should have superseded 2318; 2319 has our standard service breakdown.
- INV-2026-2320 looks like a duplicate re-issue that was exported when the billing batch retried on 2026-07-30. The two PDFs are the same line items but 2320 has a different invoice sequence ID in the footer.

My recommendation: mark 2320 as the duplicate to be voided and issue a credit memo referencing 2320 -> 2319. Since Novaforge is willing to remit undisputed amounts, there is an undisputed net of $28,400.00 (service lines excluding disputed tax rounding). We can prepare a credit memo for $6,210.00 (the difference) and confirm the canonical invoice as 2319.

Attaching a short ledger excerpt. If Laura can confirm the credit memo workflow (and I’ll prepare the GL entries), we can instruct AP to proceed with a partial wire for $28,400 by Thu 13 Aug.
